required_hardware.requirement: One designated supported mmWave sensor physically available to the campaign, with stable power and a host-supported recording interface.
acceptance_evidence: sensor serial or immutable device identifier
power and connection check recorded outside campaign capture

required_hardware.requirement: A rigid mount and measured bounded target-zone geometry fixed before the campaign lock.
acceptance_evidence: placement record with position, height, azimuth, and elevation
target-zone polygon or equivalent bounded geometry
photographic or measured mounting evidence if authorized

required_hardware.requirement: An authorized independent occupancy-reference system that continuously covers the complete target zone.
acceptance_evidence: coverage confirmation for the full target zone
retention path for immutable source evidence

required_hardware.requirement: A host with sufficient controlled storage for immutable raw recordings, telemetry, evidence receipts, and registries.
acceptance_evidence: clock source available to the host

required_software_and_tooling.requirement: A non-campaign interface checker capable of verifying raw observation availability, monotonic timestamps, continuity, and sensor-health telemetry without creating campaign evidence.
A governed artifact generator for the nine-slot pre-capture identity lock and immediate post-capture one-to-one SHA-256 receipts.
acceptance_evidence: receipt binding test from planned to actual recording identity

required_software_and_tooling.requirement: Time-synchronization and evidence-hashing tooling for the sensor, occupancy reference, and access-control evidence.
Registry tooling for recording provenance, occupancy/evidence, sensor health, and rejections.
acceptance_evidence: schema validation against a non-campaign fixture

required_evidence_and_proof.requirement: Continuous authoritative proof that no human target is present in the complete target zone for each candidate interval.
Sealed-zone or access-control proof that no animal, respiration simulator, or other physiological source is present.
Resolvable time synchronization across sensor, occupancy reference, and access-control evidence.
Immutable evidence receipts: evidence hashes and immediate post-capture SHA-256 receipt binding one actual recording to one predeclared planned recording ID.

required_personnel_and_process.requirement: Provides device access and records sensor identity, firmware, configuration, and supported interface settings.
Executes the fixed environmental protocol only after authorization; cannot manually select windows or replace a failed slot.
Reviews occupancy/access evidence and negative-class provenance; the operator cannot be the sole authoritative evidence source.
Approves the occupancy-reference mechanism, synchronization method, and one complete nine-slot pre-capture lock before any capture.

minimum_setup_for_future_preflight_pass: All HW-01 through HW-04 resources are physically available and evidenced.
All SW-01 through SW-04 tools pass their non-campaign checks and fixture demonstrations.
All EV-01 through EV-04 evidence mechanisms are approved, continuous, time synchronized, and hashable.
All PP-01 through PP-04 roles are assigned and available for the bounded campaign.
The room has controlled access, static non-human background, no animal or physiological source, no periodic mechanical reflector, and can maintain a 300-second uninterrupted empty interval.
Complete immutable values are known for every required field of all nine slots before campaign_predeclaration.json is generated.

estimated_blockers.dependency: physical access to the designated supported sensor and its raw/telemetry interface
estimated_blockers.estimate: Cannot be time-estimated from repository evidence; depends on equipment custodian access.
estimated_blockers.clear_condition: Non-campaign interface check verifies identity, raw data, timestamps, continuity, and health telemetry.

estimated_blockers.dependency: authorized independent occupancy-reference and sealed-zone/access-control mechanism
estimated_blockers.estimate: Cannot be time-estimated until the evidence authority approves a mechanism and room access is available.
estimated_blockers.clear_condition: Continuous, synchronized, hashable no-human and no-physiological-source evidence covers the complete target zone.

estimated_blockers.estimate: Bounded engineering check after HW-01 and B-02 are available; no campaign capture is needed for the demonstration.
estimated_blockers.clear_condition: Fixture evidence proves all registries, time alignment, and one-to-one receipt binding.

estimated_blockers.dependency: any failed fixed slot after a future campaign lock
estimated_blockers.estimate: No recovery estimate is allowed because replacement, top-up, reallocation, alternate recording, and second attempt are forbidden.
estimated_blockers.clear_condition: Not applicable; failure ends the bounded campaign.

preserved_governance: ABSENT means only no human target, no target physiological source, valid sensor observation, and intended negative-class evidence.
The three lineage groups and nine fixed slots remain subject-disjoint; no replacement, top-up, reallocation, alternate recording, or second attempt is allowed.
The two-stage pre-capture identity lock and post-capture immutable checksum receipt lifecycle remains required.
CHRONOLOGICAL_FIRST_N_QUALIFYING_V1 remains the only selection rule; manual easier-negative selection is forbidden.
This checklist does not authorize M-PV4, model evaluation, membership construction, or capture.
